field.name: CompletionHook.{action, authoring}
field.type: (repo: string, unit: UnitRef, port: TrackerPort, action: GuardedAction, authoring?: string) => GateOutcome | 'continue'
field.purpose: The completion hook must know which guarded action is attempted and, for author, which workflow is authoring (design.epic, design.story or plan), because author-gate maps design.story and plan to the same story unit and the two follow different signed-off stages (the HLD and the LLD). consultHook already holds both and passes them as trailing arguments, so a hook written without them keeps working.

body.rationale: Without the action and the authoring workflow the hook cannot tell which stage an attempt follows, so it would block a stage on its own signoff or miss the signoff it should check; the arguments are already available inside teamGate and consultHook, so the change is additive.
